superAdminDesc: Unrestricted access to all modules, system configuration, and user management.
systemAdminDesc: Full operational access except system-level configuration.
branchManagerDesc: Manages branch operations. Can approve loans and oversee member accounts.
loanOfficerDesc: Processes loan applications and recommends approval or rejection.
tellerDesc: Handles day-to-day cash transactions at the counter.
accountantDesc: Reviews financial records and generates reports.
auditorDesc: Read-only access across all financial data for compliance.
memberDesc: SACCO member — can view accounts, apply for loans, and make repayments.
